symbols.name: label space
symbols.meaning: The fixed space that contains every label.
symbols.quote: Fix a space $E$ of dimension $m$, the common space of all labels; here $m$ is that dimension, not the numerator of a dyadic rational.

symbols.name: label space dimension
symbols.meaning: The dimension of the label space E, counting its independent directions; this letter changes meaning on this page.
symbols.quote: Fix a space $E$ of dimension $m$, the common space of all labels; here $m$ is that dimension, not the numerator of a dyadic rational.

symbols.name: network vertex
symbols.meaning: A vertex of the network, either a gate or a terminal.
symbols.quote: Each vertex $w$ of the network, a gate or a terminal, carries a label $L(w)$, a subspace of $E$.

symbols.name: vertex label
symbols.meaning: The label L(w) of a vertex w, a subspace of E.
symbols.quote: Each vertex $w$ of the network, a gate or a terminal, carries a label $L(w)$, a subspace of $E$.

symbols.name: tail vertex
symbols.meaning: The tail vertex of an edge, the vertex where the edge starts.
symbols.quote: An edge runs from its tail $\sigma$ to its head $\nu$; these letters name vertices, not bank values.

symbols.name: head vertex
symbols.meaning: The head vertex of an edge, the vertex where the edge ends.
symbols.quote: An edge runs from its tail $\sigma$ to its head $\nu$; these letters name vertices, not bank values.

symbols.name: label projection
symbols.meaning: The projection onto the subspace U along its orthogonal complement U-perp.
symbols.quote: Each gate or sink with label $U$ has a projection $P_U$ onto $U$ along its orthogonal complement $U^\perp$.

symbols.name: vertex frame
symbols.meaning: The frame of vertex w, the operator that gives the stored array at w from the logical array.
symbols.quote: The labels are chosen to make cheap the changes of [Frame of a vertex](frame.md) on each edge: the stored array at $w$ is $D_w g$ when the logical array is $g$, and along an edge from $\sigma$ to $\nu$ it changes by $D_\nu D_\sigma^{-1}$.

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, which is the sum of the edge drops over all edges.
symbols.quote: Let $s$ be the total number of smaller calls, the sum of the drops over all edges.

relations.quote: The labels are built on a [Subset-intersection finite network](subset-network.md).
Each label sits at a gate or at a [Source, sink and terminal of a network](network-terminal.md).

The labels are chosen to make cheap the changes of [Frame of a vertex](frame.md) on each edge: the stored array at $w$ is $D_w g$ when the logical array is $g$, and along an edge from $\sigma$ to $\nu$ it changes by $D_\nu D_\sigma^{-1}$.
